text_en: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene came to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the tomb.
text_cn: 一周的第一天，清晨，天还黑的时候，玛利亚玛达肋纳来到坟墓那里，看见石头已从墓门挪开了。

text_en: So she ran and went to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we do not know where they have laid him. ”
text_cn: 于是她跑去见西满伯多禄和耶稣所爱的那另一个门徒，对他们说：“有人从坟墓中把主搬走了，我们不知道他们把他放在哪里了。”

text_en: Then Peter and the other disciple set out and went toward the tomb.
text_cn: 伯多禄便和那另一个门徒出来，往坟墓那里去了。

text_en: The two were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
text_cn: 两人一起跑，但那另一个门徒比伯多禄跑得快，先来到了坟墓那里。

text_en: He bent down to look in and saw the linen wrappings lying there, but he did not go in.
text_cn: 他俯身看见了放着的殓布，却没有进去。

text_en: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and went into the tomb. He saw the linen wrappings lying there,
text_cn: 随着他的西满伯多禄也来到了，进了坟墓，看见了放着的殓布，

text_en: and the cloth that had been on Jesus’ head, not lying with the linen wrappings but rolled up in a place by itself.
text_cn: 也看见耶稣头上的那块汗巾，不同殓布放在一起，而另在一处卷着。

text_en: Then the other disciple, who reached the tomb first, also went in, and he saw and believed;
text_cn: 那时，先来到坟墓的那个门徒，也进去了，一看见就相信了。

text_en: for as yet they did not understand the scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
text_cn: 这是因为他们还不明白，耶稣必须从死者中复活的那段圣经。

text_en: Then the disciples returned to their homes.
text_cn: 然后两个门徒又回到家里去了。

text_en: But Mary stood weeping outside the tomb. As she wept, she bent over to look into the tomb;
text_cn: 玛利亚却站在坟墓外边痛哭；她痛哭的时候，就俯身向坟墓里面窥看，

text_en: and she saw two angels in white, sitting where the body of Jesus had been lying, one at the head and the other at the feet.
text_cn: 见有两位穿白衣的天使，坐在安放过耶稣遗体的地方：一位在头部，一位在脚部。

text_en: They said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? ” She said to them, “They have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they have laid him. ”
text_cn: 那两位天使对她说：“女人！你哭什么？”她答说：“有人把我主搬走了，我不知道他们把他放在哪里了。”

text_en: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not know that it was Jesus.
text_cn: 说了这话，就向后转身，见耶稣站在那里，却不知道他就是耶稣。

text_en: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Whom are you looking for? ” Supposing him to be the gardener, she said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away. ”
text_cn: 耶稣向她说：“女人，你哭什么？你找谁？”她以为是园丁，就说：“先生，若是你把他搬走了，请告诉我，你把他放在哪里，我去取回他来。”

text_en: Jesus said to her, “Mary! ” She turned and said to him in Hebrew, “Rabbouni! ” (which means Teacher).
text_cn: 耶稣给她说：“玛利亚！”她便转身用希伯来话对他说：“辣步尼！”就是说“师傅。”

text_en: Jesus said to her, “Do not hold on to me, because I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go to my brothers and say to them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God. ’”
text_cn: 耶稣向她说：“你别拉住我不放，因为我还没有升到父那里；你到我的弟兄那里去，告诉他们：我升到我的父和你们的父那里去，升到我的天主和你们的天主那里去。”

text_en: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord”; and she told them that he had said these things to her.
text_cn: 玛利亚玛达肋纳就去告诉门徒说：“我见了主。”并报告了耶稣对她所说的那些话。

text_en: When it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and the doors of the house where the disciples had met were locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you. ”
text_cn: 正是那一周的第一天晚上，门徒所在的地方，因为怕犹太人，门户都关着，耶稣来了，站在中间对他们说：“愿你们平安！”

text_en: After he said this, he showed them his hands and his side. Then the disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord.
text_cn: 说了这话，便把手和肋膀指给他们看。门徒见了主，便喜欢起来。

text_en: Jesus said to them again, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent me, so I send you. ”
text_cn: 耶稣又对他们说：“愿你们平安！就如父派遣了我，我也同样派遣你们。”

text_en: When he had said this, he breathed on them and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
text_cn: 说了这话，就向他们嘘了一口气，说：“你们领受圣神罢！

text_en: If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you retain the sins of any, they are retained. ”
text_cn: 你们赦免谁的罪，就给谁赦免；你们存留谁的，就给谁存留。”

text_en: But Thomas (who was called the Twin ), one of the twelve, was not with them when Jesus came.
text_cn: 十二人中的一个，号称狄狄摩的多默，当耶稣来时，却没有和他们在一起。

text_en: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord. ” But he said to them, “Unless I see the mark of the nails in his hands, and put my finger in the mark of the nails and my hand in his side, I will not believe. ”
text_cn: 别的门徒向他说：“我们看见了主。”但他对他们说：“我除非看见他手上的钉孔，用我的指头，探入钉孔；用我的手，探入他的肋膀，我决不信”

text_en: A week later his disciples were again in the house, and Thomas was with them. Although the doors were shut, Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you. ”
text_cn: 八天以后，耶稣的门徒又在屋里，多默也和他们在一起。门户关着，耶稣来了，站在中间说：“愿你们平安！”

text_en: Then he said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and see my hands. Reach out your hand and put it in my side. Do not doubt but believe. ”
text_cn: 然后对多默说：“把你的指头伸到这里来，看看我的手罢！并伸过你的手来，探入我的肋膀，不要作无信的人，但要作个有信德的人。”

text_en: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God! ”
text_cn: 多默回答说：“我主！我天主！”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “Have you believed because you have seen me? Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have come to believe. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“因为你看见了我，才相信吗？那些没有看见而相信的，才是有福的！”

text_en: Now Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book.
text_cn: 耶稣在门徒前还行了许多其他的神迹，没有记在这部书上。

text_en: But these are written so that you may come to believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that through believing you may have life in his name.
text_cn: 这些所记录的，是为叫你们信耶稣是默西亚，天主子；并使你们信的人，赖他的名获得生命。
